6972-7272-7841.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
6972-7272-7841.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

3755-4770-5301-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1957-4050-4446--173.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1957-4050-4446--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1417-2738-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

997-2738-4871-6112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

210-7839.description:
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, dealing 3 damage to Smaug, Then, choose to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, with the copy targeting Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Smaug, Then, choose to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, with the copy targeting Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2921-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4772-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4772-7009-7638.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2116-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2116-2511-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

339-413-677-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-3129-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1690-2538-5034-7010.notablePrerequisites:
You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Gran-Gran.
There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1690-2538-5034-7010.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-5034-7010.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

813-6103-6492-7012.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-6595-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Squirrel by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2438-3025-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

141-3495-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-5686.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-5686.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

654-3967-5003-6644.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

3017-4094-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3017-4094-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2821-3821-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to four other lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
2821-3821-5921-5970-6120.description:
Activate up to four lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Minamo and up to four other lands.
Holding priority, activate Minamo and up to four other lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Minamo and up to four other lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Bottomless Pool by paying {U}, unlocking it.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2055-3263-3661.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {2}, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2292-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-2292-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

433-959-1637-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four Islands.
433-959-1637-4423.description:
Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Mystic Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Tidal Bore on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

864-877-2281-2292.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Repeat.

539-4687-4893.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
539-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1405-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at most five.
You have the lowest life total or are tied for the lowest life total.
1405-1692.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Scourge of the Throne with haste.
Declare the Scourge of the Throne token as an attacker, attacking the opponent with the most life or an opponent that is tied for the most life.
The Scourge of the Throne token's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, giving the token +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

656-2393-2399.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Colfenor and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-1376-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least four Elves.
618-1376-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Titania with haste.
Activate the Priest of Titania token by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1339-1926-2438.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Insect.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Insect.
The Insect dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

884-1824-2932-3168-3260.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
You have at least 3 life.
"Zombie" or "Wizard" chosen with Urza's Incubator.
884-1824-2932-3168-3260.description:
Cast Acererak by paying 2 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara and itself.
Resolve the the Ayara trigger, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve Acererak trigger, returning it to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat.
